METHOD & BOUNDARIES

Two fixed landscapes.
One synchronized clock.

Both UMAPs are calculated across the shared corpus. Selecting an audio or moving through time changes which observed videos are emphasized; it does not move the underlying coordinates.

Hashtag families come from hashtag language. Topic families come from caption context. Proximity represents semantic similarity inside each map, not influence or transmission.
